# cursor_models (Data Source)

Reads GET /v1/models, the catalog of model.id values accepted by POST /v1/agents, including parameters and variants. Do not use it to validate automation model or Admin model-access ids until Cursor confirms the catalogs are the same.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_models" "catalog" {}

output "model_ids" {
  value = data.cursor_models.catalog.models[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) models.
- `models` (Attributes List) Models, sorted by id. Lists inside a model keep the order the API returns and are empty, not null, when the API returns none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String) Alternate ids that resolve to the same model.
- `description` (String) Model description. Null when the API returns none.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable model name.
- `id` (String) Model id, the value POST /v1/agents accepts as model.id.
- `parameters` (Attributes List) Parameters the model accepts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models--parameters))
- `variants` (Attributes List) Combinations of the model id and parameter values that the model accepts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models--variants))

<a id="nestedatt--models--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models.parameters`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable parameter name. Null when the API returns none.
- `id` (String) Parameter id.
- `values` (Attributes List) Values the parameter accepts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models--parameters--values))

<a id="nestedatt--models--parameters--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models.parameters.values`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable label for the value. Null when the API returns none.
- `value` (String) Permitted value.



<a id="nestedatt--models--variants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models.variants`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Variant description. Null when the API returns none.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable variant name.
- `is_default` (Boolean) True for the variant Cursor selects when the model is chosen without parameters.
- `params` (Attributes List) Parameter values of the variant. Can be empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models--variants--params))

<a id="nestedatt--models--variants--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models.variants.params`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Parameter id.
- `value` (String) Parameter value.
